entries.context: Category theory · universal product and empty product
entries.definition: A product of a finite family (X_i) in a category C is an object P with projections P→X_i such that every family of arrows Y→X_i factors uniquely through an arrow Y→P. The empty product is a terminal object.

entries.term: tensor multiplication criterion for ring epimorphisms
entries.context: Commutative algebra · S tensor S multiplication criterion
entries.definition: For unital commutative ring map R→S, multiplication μ:S⊗_RS→S is the ring map μ(s⊗t)=st. It is an isomorphism if and only if R→S is an epimorphism in the category of commutative rings, a property weaker than surjectivity of the underlying function.
